name: Research Questions
description: Generate and resolve TRM research questions from a curator-approved batch: scan-gaps, per-question web search + confidence judgment, then recompute focus areas.
author: Soren (Cast Iron Forge)

commands.usage: /research-questions <topic>, or after curator-decision-processor finishes a batch

inputs.topic: string (required) — TRM topic name, e.g. willow-run

outputs.researchQuestionsJson: research-questions.json written to the topic's trm-ingest/ directory
outputs.focusAreasJson: focus-areas.json written to the same directory

errorConditions.message: curator-decisions-final.json not found in topic's trm-ingest/

tooltip: Generate and resolve TRM research questions from a curator-approved batch, then recompute focus areas.
